review_evidence: Game/Levels contains many checked propositional-logic examples and named theorems; Game/Levels/ExSyl.lean alone supplies a substantial library of implication, conjunction, disjunction and negation results.
Game/Doc/Lemmas.lean and individual level files contain proof examples that are directly useful as formalization/proof-pattern prior art, so educational/game provenance is not an exclusion invariant.
The complete lakefile.lean only chooses the Lean4Game server dependency, sets build/server options, pins Mathlib and declares the Game library.

rules.content_invariant: Complete inspection shows only build/dependency/server configuration; all game levels, theorem statements, examples and proof scripts remain searchable.
rules.rationale: This exact file configures Lean4Game dependencies, server options and the Game Lake target rather than formal logic content.

summary: Reviewed lean4game-logic; retain the theorem/example-rich logic game and documentation sources, excluding only the Lake/game-server build configuration.
